nonBlockingIssues.description: Stale doc comment on draw_meshes_with_skinning() says 'Billboard draws are detected by mesh vertex layout (presence of TexCoord0)' but the fix changed detection to use draw_call.is_billboard. Should say 'Billboard draws are identified by the is_billboard flag on DrawCall'.
Stale doc comment on DrawParams.billboard_pipeline says 'When a draw call's mesh has TexCoord0, this pipeline is used instead of the base pipeline.' Should reference the is_billboard flag instead.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance: when updating doc comments alongside code changes, grep for the old terminology to ensure all references are updated, not just the inline comment at the change site. Worker updated the inline comment at draw_helpers.rs:111-112 but missed doc comments at lines 38 and 48.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature fix-billboard-detection-heuristic changed billboard detection from TexCoord0 heuristic to is_billboard flag. Inline comment updated but two doc comments on DrawParams struct field (line 38) and function (line 48) still reference the old TexCoord0 heuristic.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Codify the DrawCall flag convention: when adding specialized draw types (billboard, decal, etc.) that need different pipeline routing in the render graph, always use a DrawCall-level flag/handle set by the katla_app caller. katla_gfx cannot depend on katla_app, so the caller must communicate draw type explicitly. This pattern is now established for both skinned meshes (draw_call.skeleton) and billboards (draw_call.is_billboard).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature integrate-billboard-depth-prepass initially used mesh.has_attribute(TexCoord0) which matched all PBR meshes (blocking bug). Fix feature correctly used is_billboard flag following the existing skeleton pattern. Both katla_gfx/src/renderer/types.rs and draw_helpers.rs now consistently use this approach.

rejectedObservations.observation: Billboard shaders repurpose ObjectUniforms.material_params.w as albedo bindless texture index while frame_uniforms.wgsl comments it as 'emission_idx'
rejectedObservations.reason: Already identified in round 1 synthesis and rejected as existing convention, not specific to this milestone.
